name: Tracearr
author: jmb11111
description: Active Plex/Jellyfin/Emby streams from Tracearr in the bar, with a popup showing who is watching what and today's totals.

barWidget.description: Bar pill with the active stream count and a transcode indicator; click for a popup of current streams.

defaults.stopMessage: This stream was stopped by the server admin.

schema.label: Tracearr URL
schema.description: Base URL, e.g. https://tracearr.example.com. Must not sit behind a login proxy.

schema.label: API key
schema.description: Public API key (trr_pub_…) from Tracearr Settings → General.

schema.label: Show stop-stream button
schema.description: Adds a two-click Stop button to each stream card.

schema.label: Stop message
schema.defaultValue: This stream was stopped by the server admin.
schema.description: Message the viewer sees when their stream is stopped.
